headline: Lorient, after beating leaders Monaco, go to leaking Angers
summary: Angers have conceded 10 goals in their last two Ligue 1 games, including a 2-5 home defeat to Marseille on Sunday, and sit 15th. On Sunday they host Lorient, 7th on 11 points, who beat leaders Monaco 1-0 through a Noah Cadiou penalty. Ouest-France report midfielder Haris Belkebla is still out of Angers training, so the defence that shipped five at the weekend is not yet whole. Even so, the market leans under 2.5 goals at 52.8%, and Lorient's win chance has risen from 33.9% to 39.3% in recent days. Angers are only 31.6% at home.
read: Angers are 15th in Ligue 1 and have conceded ten goals in their last two games, including a 2-5 home defeat to Marseille on Sunday. Lorient arrive seventh after beating leaders Monaco 1-0, and the market has them at 39.3% to win at Angers against 31.6% for the home side, with the handicap now favouring the visitors.

facts.meaning: Away from home, Lorient are rated the more likely winner — Angers' home advantage does not make them favourites.

facts.meaning: A game the market once had as close to even now has a clear away favourite.

facts.meaning: The 2-5 and 1-5 scorelines are not freak results — the quality of chances against Angers has been consistently high.

facts.fact: Lorient sit seventh in Ligue 1 on 11 points from seven games.
facts.meaning: Lorient are the higher-placed side coming into this match, which is why the market treats them as favourites away from home.
